raw.query: WITH f AS (SELECT e.window_bin, e.value_num, CASE e.window_bin WHEN 's' THEN 1 WHEN '10s' THEN 2 WHEN 'min' THEN 3 WHEN '10min' THEN 4 WHEN 'h' THEN 5 END AS scale_order FROM provenance.v_dim AS d JOIN provenance.eda_metric AS e USING (run_id) WHERE d.is_current = true AND e.metric_path LIKE 'fano_factor_by_window.%'), checked AS (SELECT window_bin, value_num, scale_order, LAG(value_num) OVER (ORDER BY scale_order) AS previous_value FROM f) SELECT COUNT(*) AS tested_scales, MIN(value_num) AS minimum_fano, BOOL_AND(value_num > 1) AS overdispersed_at_all_scales, BOOL_AND(previous_value IS NULL OR value_num > previous_value) AS monotonically_growing, MAX(value_num) / MIN(value_num) AS growth_factor, LN(MAX(value_num) / MIN(value_num)) / LN(10.0) AS orders_of_magnitude, STRING_AGG(window_bin || '=' || value_num::text, ', ' ORDER BY scale_order) AS values_by_window FROM checked
raw.claimed: overdispersed at every tested operational scale; grows nearly three orders of magnitude
raw.evidence: All five current full-trace Fano factors exceed 1 and increase monotonically, with 2.726 orders of magnitude between 1 s and 1 h.
